newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite holders up buy offer to $23/share.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite holders up buy offer to $23/share.

text.p: An investor group that includes members of Xpedite Systems Inc's senior management on Friday said it has raised its offer to acquire the company to $23 a share from $22.50 a share.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which last week made its offer, said it changed its offer after holding talks with the company on July 9 and July 10.
Under the terms of the latest offer, the per share price will be $23, assuming a purchase price of $85 million or less for the company's affiliate Xpedite Systems Ltd.
